modelEvidenceCorrections: The model described Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. as a fund. Direct evidence supports the name as the disclosed Axium acquisition vehicle, but the production-curated fund database has no matching Fund row. The proposal therefore stores it as vehicleName and leaves fundName null.

The Morgan Stanley URL returned by the model is browser-blocked to direct retrieval. The proposal uses Morgan Stanley's working official press-release URL for the same release and verified ownership history.

The model treated FA MGT Limited Partnership as the current parent but correctly warned that it is not an Axium-specific vehicle. The proposal preserves that distinction and does not create a separate FA MGT owner row.

The 2015 buyer release and 2018 company release identify Desjardins, Manulife, Fonds de solidarité FTQ and Industrial Alliance as consortium members. No sufficiently current direct owner roster was found, so they remain transaction history rather than unverified active 2026 ownership periods.
The company root URL redirects to an operational login page. The proposal uses the working official About page for the public website and operating facts.
The model supplied a 2024 throughput figure without a direct source in its final evidence set. The proposal omits that figure and uses the current Port of Montreal capacity table instead.

The production dry-run rejected proposal v1 before any write because the globally shared Axium portfolio Source already uses the legacy label Axiuminfra — 527 Renewables Holdings LLC. Proposal v2 preserves that Source label and type byte-for-byte while keeping a company-specific Citation evidence label.
exitSearchConclusion: No later sale, secondary, equity transfer, recapitalization that changed control, concession termination, bankruptcy or signed pending exit was identified through 2026-08-18. Axium's live portfolio still lists the asset as operational, the company and Port pages show ongoing operations, and the 2025 transaction was a debt refinancing through FA MGT rather than an ownership transfer.
